officialProductPage.evidence: Nordica's 2026/27 product page confirms lengths 167, 173, 179 and 185 cm; turn radii 16.5, 17, 17.5 and 18 m; 94 mm waist; 185 cm sidecut 128.5-94-116.5 mm; 167 cm sidecut 125-94-113 mm; 185 cm pair weight 4260 g; Energy 2 Ti Pulse Core construction; Performance Wood + Metal + Sidewall + Pulse Core materials; All Mountain rocker; True Tip and Unlocked Tail Shape; factory base angle 0.9 degrees and side angle 87.5 degrees.
officialProductPage.limitations: Official size selector lists only 167/173/179/185. The official page currently exposes full tip-waist-tail dimensions only for 167 and 185 cm; dimensions for 173 and 179 cm are intentionally not interpolated. Pair weight is only published for 185 cm.
